Windows Downloads, Desktop, Documents, OneDrive, Codex attachments, and Trash

Colab CLI history and local cloud-sync manifests

slack_forensics.scope: exact-keyword public search plus accessible private-channel/DM search; read only
slack_forensics.exact_file_search_result: No seed202, seed909, s202, s909, ens2, or train_features_v1 file attachment was found.

inaccessible_reference.description: experiment Canvas referenced together with a Wonju-Jinsan DM thread

key_messages.finding: The reported honest 70k OOF ensemble was seed42 plus seed202: 0.79070 / 0.79007 / 0.79292.
The deployed package instead used full-refit s202 INT8 plus s909 INT4, raw-margin<1.0 gating, logit averaging, and a 430-second guard.
R1b was reported as rechecked on two s202 folds, but no component logits, weights, fold files, or commands were attached.

slack_forensics.seed909_oof_evidence: No seed909 or s909 OOF record or attachment exists in the searchable workspace.

drive_and_colab_forensics.google_drive_connector: Exact filename/content searches returned zero AADP artifact matches; the connector appears to expose a different Drive view than the configured rclone remote.
drive_and_colab_forensics.rclone_result: Recursive filename/size scans and model/anchor/run listings found seed42 champion OOF and ordinary training artifacts, but no seed202, seed909, s202, s909, or ens2 package/model/logit artifact.
drive_and_colab_forensics.live_lane_handling: Lanes A and B were active with unrelated terminal-token experiments and were inspected read-only without interrupting or mutating them.
drive_and_colab_forensics.external_team_surface: The ensemble package and seed909 instance were produced on team-side infrastructure outside the accessible exchanges.

provenance_mismatch.consequence: Even recovering the reported seed42+seed202 OOF would not be the exact deployed disagreement/margin surface. No honest seed202+seed909 OOF is reported to have existed.

minimum_materials_for_exact_recovery: seed202 INT8 and seed909 INT4 model directories with hf_meta and exact script.py
or both ID-aligned component OOF logits with fold metadata and the exact ensemble operation order

decision.new_training_is_not_forensic_recovery: A fresh seed202/909 run would not guarantee the same trained instances or quantization error and would not recreate the historical package surface.
decision.remaining_rule_search: No further practical row-local, label-free rule family remains unsearched; the only residual uncertainty is inaccessible/nonexistent exact-instance surface validation.
decision.deployment_implication: Keep read_file -0.14 rejected as universal. Rank conservative sequence H first; preserve immutable-base, non-cascading semantics for all rules.
